STDG.description: Story Diaphragm Group (STDG). Associates a story (the id key = story key) with a boundary group; both the story name and the target boundary group name are required.

STORY_NAME.description: Story name of the diaphragm group. The id key is the story key; on GET this is read from the story definition.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name to associate with the story. Must reference an existing boundary group (BNGR); an empty/unknown name is rejected at runtime with a WRONG_FIELD error.
